learn_source: Watch the priest send the censer smoke up straight at the Festival Grounds — the rite that calls the souls home is read in the rising column
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something that smokes or scents once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the column rises tall and unbroken; at baseline it climbs a body-height and frays. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Gathers and rises in a single straight column, undisturbed by breeze
State-dependent: backing up and smoky, the draft rights itself and pulls clean; drawing fine already, nothing changes
The dust lifts in a thin sheet and drifts out the doorway
no_effect — nothing about it can rise or drift
No physical effect — the lift does not attach to a living body
receivers.reaction_kind: watches the moving dust, pounce-stalks it
plainly states what the caster just tried to do to him
